dsh-chat-imagine 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。通过已配置的 OpenAI 兼容生图模型或本机 MiniMax CLI，在 DeepSeek Harness 对话中生成并展示图片。

posts.en:
dsh-chat-imagine is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Generates images in DeepSeek Harness through configured OpenAI-compatible image models or a local MiniMax CLI, and displays the result in chat.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-56f70297a773f7909de9.html
